leads.name: Ubud Monkey Forest giant banyan
leads.reason: Banyan in the middle of the Sacred Monkey Forest Sanctuary (Padangtegal), paid entry. Only age claim is 'at least 100 years' from a travel blog (TheSmartLocal); temples are 14th century but no source ties the tree to them. A wood, not one spot: no pin, no age source. Safety event Dec 2024 (trees fell, two visitors died, forest closed for a time per press): re-check it is open and the tree stands before any work. Needs a geotagged photo or the forest management's own tree list.

leads.name: Trunyan Taru Menyan tree
leads.reason: Sacred fragrant tree beside the Trunyan cemetery on Lake Batur, said to be about 1,100 years old (one travel site, unverified; the 1,600 years in other sources is the village). Reached by a 15 minute boat from the village; cemetery with exposed remains, a guide advised. Species unresolved (frankincense, banyan, myrrh all claimed). Single weak age source, no pin, sensitive site: lead only, needs a botanical identification and a respectful access check.

leads.name: Waringin Sungsang, Selat (Karangasem)
leads.reason: Named once in an Indonesian listing as a banyan near a temple gate in Desa Adat Selat; no age, pin, photo or second source found. Lead for a local-language search.

leads.name: Sangeh Monkey Forest nutmeg trees (Dipterocarpus trinervis), Pura Bukit Sari
leads.reason: [SKIPPED 2026-11-07 by the write pass: a wood, not one point, and a December 2025 storm felled 30+ trees; which trunks stand is unknown] A wood of tall straight dipterocarps up to about 40 m (Travelfish; NOW Bali says 30 m), some said to be 300 years old by local elders, planted as a Mengwi royal garden around a 17th century temple. Wood, not one collectible spot, and a storm on 3 Dec 2025 brought down more than 30 trees and killed a staff member (press): re-check which individual trunks still stand, whether open, before anything. Coordinates are the general area, not verified. Needs one named veteran with a pin.

leads.name: Kepuh Agung, Ngurah Rai airport (Tuban, Kuta)
leads.reason: Sacred kepuh about 4 m wide and 20 m high beside the domestic cargo terminal; priest says several hundred years old, Japanese lookout in the war, shrines on the trunk, walled with a small south entrance, people visit daily (Jakarta Post 2016-05-12, only substantive source; TravelingYuk 2019-07-05 only says the tree belonged to Pura Tegal Melakang, which was moved, so unclear whether the tree remains). No coordinate found (Nominatim empty), no dated sighting after 2016, airport expansion since may have changed access. Needs an OSM or photo pin, a recent mention and an access check.

leads.name: Old Giant Tree, Jalan Raya Pelaga (Mungsengan, Petang, Badung)
leads.reason: [SKIPPED 2026-11-07 by the write pass: OSM node only, no species, age or source] Only an OSM natural=tree node named 'Old Giant Tree' tagged tourism=attraction (node 11781902566), nothing else found in English or Indonesian searches. No species, age or alive evidence: lead, needs a source.

leads.name: Sangeh Lanang Wadon tree (Pura Bukit Sari forest)
leads.species: disputed (called nutmeg/pala; one source says milkwood pine)
leads.reason: Named sacred tree whose trunk has a hole with a second trunk emerging (male-female), by the temples at the forest entrance (visitbali.id undated; other results conflict on species). No age, no pin; Sangeh lost 30+ trees in the storm of 3 Dec 2025, so alive check is needed before anything.

leads.name: Munduk second banyan node (OSM 4345222406)
leads.reason: [SKIPPED 2026-11-07 by the write pass: may be the live bli_005; no source] OSM natural=tree 'Banyan Tree' 290 m from the Gesing giant banyan (bli_005). May be a second tree or the same one; no source. Check with aerial imagery before treating as separate.

blocked.name: Puri Kantor Ubud banyan
blocked.reason: Fell (detik.com Bali report: banyan 2 m across and 25 m tall toppled onto buildings at Puri Kantor, Ubud); known dead, do not ship. Date not seen on a fetched page.
